_comment: Team Rocket Hideout (scripts/modes/rocket.gd, scripts/data/rocket.gd). Open every Saturday and Sunday, plus weekday_days random weekdays each week. Pick one Pokémon and beat three Grunts (three of the grunt teams, picked for the day) and then two Executives (two of the executives) in a row, first to kills_to_win KOs each round. Your Pokémon has lives faints for the whole run; run out and it's over. Every enemy is a Shadow Pokémon: tougher, hits harder, and the Executive's ace is bigger and gets enraged when hurt.

rewards._comment: Each round won pays round_money x the round number. A full clear pays clear (per difficulty). Only your first clear of each difficulty per open day pays in full: after that, rounds and clears that day pay repeat_share of the money and coins, and no Rare Candy or balls, so the Hideout can't be farmed for cash. The first clear of each difficulty per open day also gives the next piece of that difficulty's Team Rocket outfit (normal: the black Grunt uniform, hard: the white Executive one), in piece_order; once you have it all, an extra ball instead. Your first ever Hard clear gives a Master Ball.
